title: Lab monogram and name
slide_intent: Give the institution a stable signature so audiences can recognize the whole laboratory across diverse research.
strategic_value: A fixed lab mark can accumulate recognition while related group marks express differences.
demonstration: A black angular ML monogram sits beside a three-line lowercase name on white.
practical_value: Evaluate the relationship between a compact symbol and a readable institutional name.
